name: mai-cyber-gallery
description: Reproducible asset tooling for Mai Cyber Gallery.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery.min.js && terser assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-packing.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-packing.min.js && terser assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-lightbox.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-lightbox.min.js && terser assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-editor.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-editor.min.js
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && node --test && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check:syntax: node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery.min.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-packing.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-packing.min.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-lightbox.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-lightbox.min.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-editor.js && node --check assets/js/mai-cyber-gallery-editor.min.js
